paite: Kumpipa aw, ka Pathian, ka hon pahtawi ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
heading: David Phatna La
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

paite: Niteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi; athupidan suikhiak vual ahi kei hi.
english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

paite: Suan khat in suan dang kiang ah na thilhihte aphat sawnsawn ding a, na thilhih thupitakte atheisak ding hi.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

paite: Nangmah pahtawina kilawmdan thupitak leh na thillamdang hihte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

paite: Mite'n na thilhih mulkimhuaite hatdan agen ding ua; ke'n leng na thupidan ka theisak sam ding hi.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

paite: Na hoihna thupitak atheih uh agen ding ua, na diktatna nuamsatak in la in asa ding uhi.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

paite: TOUPA mihehpih thei, chitna a dim, lungnel, zahngaihna thupitak nei ahi.
english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

paite: TOUPA bangkim tung ah leng ahoih hi; athilsiamte tung ah zahngaihnate a-om hi.
english: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

paite: TOUPA aw, na thilsiam teng in na kiang ah kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua; misiangthoute'n nang ahon phat ding uhi.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

paite: Na gam thupidan thu gen in, na thilhihtheihna thu houlimna in azang ding ua;
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

paite: Mihing tate kiang a athilhih thupitakte leh agam kilawmna thupidan theisak ding in.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

paite: Na gam tangtawn gam ding ahi a, na thuneihna suan om sung teng in a-om gige ding hi. TOUPA athute ah amuanhuai a, anasepte ah deihsak asiam hi.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

paite: TOUPA'N apukte alen gige a, kun kheukheu a omte akaitang hi.
english: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

paite: Amau tengteng mit nang tung ah atu a; ahuntak ah an nek ding uh na pia hi;
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

paite: na khut na zak a, thil hing teng deih na hihtaisak hi.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

paite: TOUPA alampi tengteng ah adik a, anasep peuhmah a mihehpih thei ahi.
english: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

paite: TOUPA amah min lou tengteng kiang ah anai hi; thudik a amah lou peuhmahte kiang ah.
english: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

paite: Amah laute deihlam ahihtangtung ding a; akahna uh aza ding a, ahondam ding hi.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

paite: Amah it tengteng TOUPA'N ahawi a; himahleh migilou ahihmangthang ding.
english: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

paite: TOUPA phatna ka kam in agen ding a; sa tengteng in amin siangthou tangtawn tangtawn in phat uhen!
english: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
